July 4, 1944

London, England

Supreme Headquarters Allied Expeditionary Force

 

Anthony looked around, the park was overrun with soldiers, barricades, tents, jeeps, you name it it was there.  Otherwise, it would probably be very beautiful.  If Tyler Vance was correct, General Eisenhower would be in Normandy and Paul Parsons VII will be here for a secret meeting about some suspicious happenings that would turn out to be the launch of Fyodor Romonat's War-Zeppelins.  This is where Ivan Romonat, mistaken to be Fyodor's cousin would murder Parsons, and supposedly create the world he had grown up in.  If Parsons lives, Romonat is stopped, and Parsons' son is around to lead them against Voss.

The mood was noticably lax on the base.  Anthony looked around, trying to get an eye on Parsons.

Instead he saw approaching one of the smaller tents three men, one in some kind of shiny metal suit, another one, he was huge and wearing some serious armor, even if it did look pretty beat up, the last one was a freaking cowboy, with one arm?

"What the heck. . ." Anthony got up and started to follow them.

Looking around the edge of the tent he could see them, and what looked to be Parsons, they were arguing.  None of them looked like Romonat.

Suddenly he heard a yell "You won't live that long old man!" and then an explosion.  They were attacking Parsons, Anthony ran around the tent, trying to get over on Parsons side, as he arrived a man in an armored suit ran by him to check on Parsons.

He ran up behind him and as he did he could feel the air around him feel warp, things seemed really wierd, like it had in the portal.

"The generator is operational, this time will be fixed." the shiny metal man stated.

"What?" Parsons asked as he got up.

"He means that when you die here, now, you die everywhere." The cowboy added.

"And with you dies your son!"

 

EPISODE 7:

PVP Match

Number of Heroes:  6

Team 1:  Omnitron-X, Crono Ranger, Bunker EOW

Team 2:  Greatest Legacy, GI Bunker, The Argent Adept

Environment:  Time Cataclysm

How the round works:

Omnitron-X and Greatest Legacy are captains, after all heroes have players they will report the order of play to me through a PM.  The Environment will go first, Team 1 will have their first hero play, then Team 2 will have their first hero play, then Team 1 2nd, Team 2 2nd, T1 3rd, T2 3rd, start over.

How the mechanics of PVP will work:

The team you are on count as hero targets for your cards.  The other team count as villain targets for your cards.  Cards that destroy villain ongoing cards may destroy equipment or ongoing cards.  Cards that affect the environment affect the environment.  Environment cards treat both teams as heroes and villains.  Cards like Crushing hallway can be destroyed by anyone from either team.

If a hero plays a card that destroys a card, the hero playing the card chooses what to destroy.

If an environment destroys a card your team chooses, anyone can choose for their team if others are taking a while to get back on.

Further environment card clarifications:

Main computer room will play the top card of the environment deck instead of the villain deck.

Marsquake will destroy one card from each team, and one from the environment (instead of one villain, one hero, one environment)

Other Issues:

Don't feel that there is a right or wrong side to play on, this match doesn't make a huge impact in the story line, but it brings two of the original six possibilities back together and lets us rebuild a team.  Do your best to crush the other team, and don't take it too seriously, PVP is not balanced.

This hopefully will go quickly, gang up on people, fight as dirty as you can, and be polite.

Any issues/questions as to how things work will be resolved by me.

So, first come, first serve, lets see what the future holds!

If you don't think you would like PVP play anyway, I need six people to play this match so we can get back to the normal games and standard matches.  This is the only PVP match we will see.

If you want more on your characters rational and backstory let me know, I'm happy to share.

Feel free to communicate by PM, there are spies from both teams watching this thread.

Jim Brooks felt like the steps at the old Stable after the Hayes boys had run through town.  He looked at his side, the bleeding had stopped thanks to all that metal tech Con had stuck in him, but the skin hadn't repaired yet and he looked a mess.  Those metal suits packed a punch, he'd have to talk to Con about getting something to blast through armor like that, or maybe some of that armor for himself.

He looked aroung him.  That Legacy guy they were after was still standing, and the fight seemed over.  Part of him worried about the consequences, the tyrant.  Mostly though he was relieved, that guy was a soldier fighting for America, not some monster.

"Con, status." Jim coughed.

. . .

Anthony laid back and closed his eyes.  Legacy was alive, he had done it, Legacy was still alive.  Baron Blade was still out there, but this first attempt on the Legacy line had failed, and he would be here for any others.  He just needed to rest.

. . .

Omnitron-X looked over his process log, errors were made.  Errors due to innacurate information.  His systems had not fully rebooted when the second temporal disruption had occured, the inteligence known as Con was inferior, but the logs were clear.  He would need to gather data on the timeline changes, errors were not something he was programmed to tolerate, let alone repeat.

. . .

The metal man was gone, just vanished.

"Con, that robot disappearred, track him." Jim ordered, he wasn't about to lose track of that thing.

Con replied, but Jim was busy, he had questions that needed answers.  One thing he had gotten used to in time travel, it didn't matter when you left, you still arrived at the same time.

. . .

"Alright soldier, on your feet."

Anthony wasn't a soldier, and he didn't need to stand; the speaker pulled him upright anyway.  It was him, it was the great big hero, Legacy, right there in front of him.  A handsome man with a warm smile and a grip like a steel vice.

"We've got a lot of stories here, and I'm thinking yours just might help tie all of this mess together."  Legacy had a suprisingly gentle voice, but his smile and posture were straight up Alpha Male, Anthony was looking at the epitome of a man's man, but inspite of himself, he liked him.  He couldn't help feeling that everything was going to be OK, and he couldn't help telling everything he knew.

 

Thanks for playing the PVP everyone!

I found the PVP to be

A. horrible

B. fun if not balanced, good for a one-time thing

C. meh

D. would do it again

E.  I loved it!

posts.name: PlatinumWarlock
posts.cooked:
For me, it's somewhere between B and C.

Part of the biggest issue is the ability for players to actively target one hero and hammer them into the ground.  Team Future did that early on to make Argent Adept a non-factor, while Team Past did much the same (though it took longer) with Chrono-Ranger.  Eliminating heroes early makes things un-fun for those players.  I imagine that if I were one of those players, I'd have checked out almost entirely.

I felt the game really went overlong, particularly when it was myself and Legacy sitting back and staring at one another--him playing Next Evolution, then me countering and destroying it, over and over.  I do feel like cards that prevent damage entirely (Next Evolution, Hypersonic Assault, etc.) really are powerful in this setup, as they can effectly shut another team down.  My biggest worry on Team Future was the Next Evolution/Lead From The Front combo (which, obviously, never materialized), as Team Future was so dependent on projectile damage.

Honestly, I can't say I'd be interested in playing another PvP scenario.  I'm eager to get back to beating up on villains.

No matter what happened there would be serious consequences, if he was allowed to attack the allied command infrastructure the push into Germany would bog down and the Soviets would conquer most of Germany.  Stalin would take the move as a sign of weakness and start a third world war that would be fought with atomic bombs and super weapons created by Ivan and Fyodor Romonat.  The end result would not be good for anyone.

In other lines Baron Blade lies low, bides his time and kills Legacy and thePresident of the United States in the early 60's, still before he would have a son.  The resulting whitch hunt would create paranoia and Super Humans would be hunted and the end result was Voss ruling the Earth.

If Blade was allowed to attempt to join his father, Fyodor would have him killed, convinced he was a spy.  Convinced others knew of his plans he would ally with certain powers in the Communist Party and there would still be a third World War, in the early 80's with a nuclear shield protecting certain cities in the Soviet Union while the rest of the planet burned.

There was one point Omnitron could lock down in Blade's actions, he would be heading to Paris to plan his next move.

posts.cooked:
Thanks again for running these. I think I'm somewhere around a B. A few thoughts:

  • Ongoing/equipment destruction is super-powerful. When creating teams, I think it would be important to balance ongoing destruction (everyone on Team Future has it, but only one on Team Past). Maybe the person doing the destroying doesn't get to pick what gets destroyed? It could be random or the destroyee could choose.
  • Alternating play order seems to give a slight benefit to the team that goes first. You might consider revising the order to A1, B1, B2, A2, A3, B3 instead of A1, B1, A2, B2, A3, B3.
  • The environment was more annoying than anything; especially in situations where destroying the environment card benefits everyone on both teams but one person on one team has to pay the price to get rid of it. This might be worse for some environments than others - Silver Gulch (with Lost in Time removed) would probably be OK.
  • Echo PlatinumWarlock - it's a little less fun when one player gets focused down and eliminated right off the bat. Maybe make it so that players don't get incapped - you have to get everyone on the other team down to zero HP, but individuals who are at (or below) zero keep their cards and keep on fighting. It might be appropriate to start with less HP to keep the game from dragging out.
